name: Recharge
one_liner: An online store where consumers buy digital gift cards, prepaid payment cards, and mobile top-ups.
what_you_sell: Digital gift cards, prepaid payment cards, mobile phone top-ups, and game vouchers.
target_group: Partnership managers and channel sales directors at telecom carriers, game publishers, and prepaid financial service providers with 50 to 5,000 employees. A good prospect is a business that issues prepaid cards or digital airtime and needs to reach online consumers globally.
b2c_note: The site is a consumer online store, but its business partners are telecom carriers, game publishers, and fintech issuers supplying prepaid inventory for resale.
who_uses_it: Consumers who want to buy mobile top-ups, game vouchers, and prepaid payment cards online.
who_pays_for_it: Individual consumers purchasing cards, alongside telecom carriers and brand partners selling their vouchers on the platform.
who_buys_it: Telecom operators, gaming companies, and prepaid card issuers seeking digital retail distribution channels.
_claims_to_check: Claims to be the largest online store for payment cards, gift cards, and mobile top-ups.
Claims 99.7% of orders are delivered within 5 seconds.
_note: Fill in sender and cannot_claim, then set reviewed to true. Nothing downstream will run until you do. See _claims_to_check for what the tool noticed your site implies.
